name: Own a Grocery Store 🛒
desc:
🛒 BUILD YOUR DREAM GROCERY STORE!

Start with one tiny checkout. Stock the shelves, serve customers, earn cash, and grow your store into a huge supermarket!

HOW TO PLAY:
🥬 Grow fresh ingredients and unlock new groceries  
📦 Stock your shelves and keep customers happy  
💵 Serve shoppers, earn cash, and expand your store  
👥 Hire cashiers, stockers, farmers & cooks to automate the work  
🏗️ Unlock new aisles, farms, animals & machines  
⬆️ Upgrade your character, workers & production  

🚚 Complete timed delivery orders for big rewards  
🎁 Finish quests, claim daily rewards & spin for prizes  
🎨 Unlock new outfits and pets as you grow  

Can you build the ultimate grocery store?

👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite + 🔔 Follow for new updates!

llm.loop: stock shelves and serve customers -> earn cash -> hire cashiers and farmers to automate -> unlock aisles, farms and machines -> complete deliveries and quests
llm.objectives: grow a tiny checkout into a supermarket
llm.instructions: grow ingredients, stock, serve, hire, expand; like, favorite, follow
monetization_signals: price surge and rush hour boosts 19-89
llm.thumbnails: player carrying a stack of groceries; a busy supermarket; 'UPDATE 3' banner
llm.complexity_notes: many shop systems, NPC customers, workers
